title: PhoneReplicaWriteService
responsibility: Validate an approved phone write and commit the Tracker transition and idempotency receipt together.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.constructor.store
inputs.description: The authoritative hub SQLite journal used to commit the intent and receipt together.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.constructor.now
inputs.description: Provides the current time in milliseconds for retention and the canonical Tracker transition.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.constructor.grant
inputs.description: The one approved device ID and its private loopback bearer, configured by the hub operator.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.scope.headers
inputs.description: Loopback request headers naming the approved phone and its scope and carrying the private bearer.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.push.scope
inputs.description: The authenticated 64-character scope derived from the host, device and pairing generation.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.push.fields
inputs.description: Version 1 intent with UUID, exact item ID, operation, bounded text and the attention revision for flag and answer.

outputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.scope
outputs.description: Returns the device scope after comparing the configured device and bearer, or null when access is denied.

outputs.name: PhoneReplicaWriteService.push
outputs.description: Returns an accepted receipt or a conflict. A retry of the same committed intent returns the same receipt.

errors.name: invalidPhoneIntent
errors.description: The local API returns HTTP 400 for invalid or unsafe intent fields.

errors.name: writeStorage
errors.description: The underlying journal or receipt write fails and rolls back the transaction.
